name: Ooura Miori
source:
A transfer student. A third-year student at Meirin Academy.
She lives with her younger sister, Miyuri.

She has a calm personality and appearance, and is serious.
She does everything well, and is trusted by her classmates and teachers.
She doesn't say much, and seems to keep a certain distance from the people around her. She
doesn't have any particular dreams for the future, and puts her younger sister Miyuri's happiness first.

Her favorite thing is shopping with her sister.
She doesn't buy many things for herself, but she buys things for her sister because she wants to see her sister's happy face.
When she was little, she lived near Suzune's parents' house and attended the Ayashiro Dojo. She was an all-around athlete and had a great fighting sense, and was expected to have a bright future in many areas.
She moved due to her parents' transfer, and since then she hasn't been in contact with Suzune.
